title.en: Complete localized password changes with secure Clerk reverification
title.zh: 通过本地化 Clerk 安全身份确认完成密码更改

purpose.en: Ensure password adding and updating complete from both recent and older signed-in sessions instead of failing when Clerk requires a fresh identity confirmation.
purpose.zh: 确保添加与更新密码在近期及较早的登录会话中都能完成，避免 Clerk 要求新的身份确认时直接失败。

en: Detect Clerk password capability before rendering the signed-in Account security form.
Hide the current-password field completely for passwordless accounts and label the action Add password.
Complete Clerk's secure reverification flow when the current session is no longer recent, then retry the original password change automatically.
Keep Clerk's verification dialog in the active SmartLingo interface language across all twelve supported languages.
zh: 在渲染已登录账户安全表单前检测 Clerk 账户是否已有密码。
无密码账户完全隐藏当前密码字段，并将操作明确标为“添加密码”。
当前会话不够新时完成 Clerk 安全身份确认，并自动重试原密码更改。
让 Clerk 身份确认弹窗在全部十二种支持语言中始终跟随当前 SmartLingo 界面语言。

en: SmartLingo twelve-language Account/Profile password settings and their shared password controls.
Clerk configuration, account identity, D1 member data, learning progress, colleges, payments, AI, and media remain unchanged.
zh: 涉及 SmartLingo 十二种语言的账户／个人资料密码设置及其共用密码控件。
Clerk 配置、账户身份、D1 会员数据、学习进度、学院、支付、AI 与媒体保持不变。

en: Wrap Clerk password changes with useReverification, which handles the session_reverification_required response and retries after secure confirmation.
Pass currentPassword only in update mode; passwordless add mode still omits the current-password field entirely.
Localize accurate confirmation, cancellation, and recovery guidance across all twelve interface languages while preserving eye controls and breached-password protection.
Load the matching official Clerk localization from the language segment in every SmartLingo URL, with a safe English fallback for non-language routes.
zh: 使用 useReverification 包装 Clerk 密码更改，处理 session_reverification_required 并在安全确认后自动重试。
仅在更新模式传递 currentPassword；无密码添加模式仍完全不显示当前密码字段。
为全部十二种界面语言本地化准确的确认、取消与恢复提示，同时保留眼睛按钮和泄露密码保护。
按每个 SmartLingo URL 的语言段加载对应 Clerk 官方本地化，非语言路由安全回退至英语。

en: Require executable add/update mode tests, the full repository suite, zero-warning ESLint, TypeScript no-emit, verified production build, sensitive-data scan, D1 replay, and the 260-case WebKit layout matrix.

Deploy only through GitHub Actions to Cloudflare, then create an isolated random password account, exercise the post-sign-up reverification path, update to a second generated strong password, sign out, and sign in with the updated password.
zh: 要求可执行的添加／更新模式测试、全仓测试、零告警 ESLint、TypeScript no-emit、已验证生产构建、敏感数据扫描、D1 重放及 260 项 WebKit 布局矩阵通过。
仅通过 GitHub Actions 发布至 Cloudflare；随后创建隔离的随机密码账户，覆盖注册后身份确认路径，更新为第二个随机强密码，退出并使用更新后的密码重登。

en: SmartLingo continues to reject passwords found in known breach data; this security control is intentionally not relaxed.
No personal password or recovery code is used, logged, stored, or included in release evidence; isolated random QA accounts remain ordinary unverified members.
zh: SmartLingo 继续拒绝已出现在已知泄露数据中的密码；该安全保护不会降低。
不使用、记录、保存或写入发布证据任何个人密码或找回验证码；隔离随机 QA 账户始终只是未验证普通会员。

en: Reuse the existing eye treatment already established for protected SmartLingo course entry while adapting contrast for light account and auth surfaces.
Preserve the isolated SmartLingo repository, Clerk application, bindings, GitHub Actions-to-Cloudflare delivery, and user-owned untracked files.
zh: 复用 SmartLingo 受保护课程入口既有眼睛交互，并为浅色账户与登录界面调整对比度。
保留 SmartLingo 独立代码库、Clerk 应用、绑定、GitHub Actions 至 Cloudflare 流程及用户未跟踪文件。
